info.title: MusicGetter Extension API
info.description: Rendered metadata only. No Spotify/Yandex/VK credentials, cookies, source auth headers, HTML or extra JSON properties. Bearer means MusicGetter token only. JSON property names are case-sensitive; duplicates rejected. All responses no-store. CORS allows only exact configured chrome-extension/moz-extension origins; no Origin is permitted for extension service workers/native tools with Bearer. No cookie authentication. Limits are per-process fixed-minute windows: IP 120, owner 60, pair claim IP 5; configurable via environment. Retry-After on 429. Reverse proxy headers are not trusted.

servers.description: Local development only; production must use HTTPS.

post.description: Consume a bot-issued code and issue a 30-day MusicGetter session. Token is returned once. Lost response requires a new /connect; no replay can retrieve the token. No Authorization header on this endpoint.

X-Request-ID.description: Safe correlation ID, also included in errors.

get.description: Current user and authenticated extension session. No request body.

X-Request-ID.description: Safe correlation ID, also included in errors.

get.description: Owner-scoped saved destination collections; no calls to a music bot. Empty until a destination is provisioned. UUID keyset; next_cursor may lead to an empty final page.

post.description: Create import (state created) and find/create source profile/collection for current user. client_request_id is unique per user; canonical typed payload is immutable across retries. Destination must belong to current user.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: If supplied, must equal client_request_id (create) or idempotency_key (tracks).

post.description: Atomic chunk (1..200 tracks, <=512 KiB). Maximum 100,000 observations and 10,000 chunks per import. Sequence starts at 0; out-of-order chunks allowed. Same key + sequence + typed payload returns original receipt with replay=true, even after complete/cancel. Key/sequence reuse with changed payload returns 409. Track identity deduplicates across chunks; first accepted observation wins. No jobs before complete.

X-Request-ID.description: Safe correlation ID, also included in errors.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: If supplied, must equal client_request_id (create) or idempotency_key (tracks).

post.description: Seal upload, require all chunks 0..last_sequence and exact observed_count; create jobs atomically. Empty upload uses last_sequence=-1 and observed_count=0. Only visible_end_confirmed permits complete. Same typed body is replay-safe; changed body returns 409. Idempotency-Key header is not accepted here. Response reflects current state.

X-Request-ID.description: Safe correlation ID, also included in errors.

post.description: Idempotently cancel created/receiving/queued/processing imports. Empty body or {} only. Prevent new writes/jobs; already applied external effects are not reversed; leased/uncertain effects require worker reconciliation.

X-Request-ID.description: Safe correlation ID, also included in errors.

get.description: Owner-only aggregate progress and contiguous chunk receipt prefix; never returns entire track library. Unknown/foreign import returns 404.

extensionBearer.description: Own MusicGetter session token, never a streaming credential.

code.description: One-time 128-bit Base32 code from /connect. Case-insensitive, surrounding whitespace trimmed by server.

anyOf.description: Rendered link for the import source only. No userinfo, port, query, fragment, cookies or tokens. Never fetched.

last_sequence.description: -1 for empty capture; otherwise zero-based last sequence.

observed_count.description: Sum of tracks across unique accepted chunks, including repeated observations.
